name: Piracy Reworked
author: Tristan
description: The black market is pirate infrastructure - and every credit that moves through the underworld is revenue for it. Your smuggling, the sector's own illegal trade, and commissions placed through underworld contacts all feed a pirate war chest that finances raids and new bases. Order goods no legal market sells - stolen from real colonies by real raids. Personal bounties, fading wariness, and a closed-loop pirate economy you can starve or bankroll. Standalone. Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
